segments.mn143:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn143:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.mn143:2.2: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn143:2.3: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi [vandāhi evañca vadehi (sabbattha) aññasuttesu pana natthi]–
segments.mn143:2.6: Yena cāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandāhi [vandāhi evañca vadehi (sabbattha) aññasuttesu pana natthi]–
segments.mn143:2.8: So āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
segments.mn143:2.10: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.mn143:2.11: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so puriso anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn143:2.14: Yena cāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn143:2.16: So āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandati;
segments.mn143:2.18: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.mn143:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn143:3.2: “kacci te, gahapati, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ? Kacci te dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.mn143:4.1: “Na me, bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo.
segments.mn143:4.2: Seyyathāpi, bhante sāriputta, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani [muddhānaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] abhimattheyya [abhimantheyya (sī. pī.)]; evameva kho me, bhante sāriputta, adhimattā vātā muddhani [ohananti (syā. kaṃ.)] ūhananti [adhimattā vātā sīlaṃ parikantanti (sī. syā. kaṃ.)].
segments.mn143:4.3: Na me, bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo.
segments.mn143:4.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante sāriputta, balavā puriso daḷhena varattakhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya; evameva kho me, bhante sāriputta, adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā.
segments.mn143:4.5: Na me, bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo.
segments.mn143:4.6: Seyyathāpi, bhante sāriputta, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya; evameva kho me, bhante sāriputta, adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
segments.mn143:4.7: Na me, bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo.
segments.mn143:4.8: Seyyathāpi, bhante sāriputta, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ, samparitāpeyyuṃ; evameva kho me, bhante sāriputta, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
segments.mn143:4.9: Na me, bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.mn143:5.2: ‘na cakkhuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:5.5: ‘na sotaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me sotanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:5.8: ‘na ghānaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me ghānanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:5.11: ‘na jivhaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me jivhānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:5.14: ‘na kāyaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me kāyanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:5.17: ‘na manaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manonissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:6.2: ‘na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:6.5: ‘na saddaṃ upādiyissāmi … pe … na gandhaṃ upādiyissāmi … na rasaṃ upādiyissāmi … na phoṭṭhabbaṃ upādiyissāmi … na dhammaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me dhammanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:7.2: ‘na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhuviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:7.5: ‘na sotaviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi … na ghānaviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi … na jivhāviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi … na kāyaviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi … na manoviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manoviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:8.2: ‘na cakkhusamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:8.5: ‘na sotasamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi … na ghānasamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi … na jivhāsamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi … na kāyasamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi … na manosamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:9.2: ‘na cakkhusamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassajāvedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:9.5: ‘na sotasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na ghānasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na jivhāsamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na kāyasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na manosamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassajāvedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:10.2: ‘na pathavīdhātuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me pathavīdhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:10.5: ‘na āpodhātuṃ upādiyissāmi … na tejodhātuṃ upādiyissāmi … na vāyodhātuṃ upādiyissāmi … na ākāsadhātuṃ upādiyissāmi … na viññāṇadhātuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:11.2: ‘na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:11.5: ‘na vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na saññaṃ upādiyissāmi … na saṅkhāre upādiyissāmi … na viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:12.2: ‘na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me ākāsānañcāyatananissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:12.5: ‘na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi … na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me nevasaññānāsaññāyatananissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:13.2: ‘na idhalokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me idhalokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:14.2: ‘na paralokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me paralokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:14.5: ‘yampi me diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anupariyesitaṃ anucaritaṃ manasā tampi na upādiyissāmi, na ca me taṃnissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.mn143:15.1: Evaṃ vutte, anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati parodi, assūni pavattesi.
segments.mn143:15.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn143:15.3: “olīyasi kho tvaṃ, gahapati, saṃsīdasi kho tvaṃ, gahapatī”ti?
segments.mn143:15.5: api ca me dīgharattaṃ satthā payirupāsito manobhāvanīyā ca bhikkhū;
segments.mn143:15.6: na ca me evarūpī dhammī kathā sutapubbā”ti.
segments.mn143:15.7: “Na kho, gahapati, gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhāti;
segments.mn143:15.8: pabbajitānaṃ kho, gahapati, evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhātī”ti.
segments.mn143:15.9: “Tena hi, bhante sāriputta, gihīnampi odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhātu.
segments.mn143:15.10: Santi hi, bhante, kulaputtā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti;
segments.mn143:16.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca ānando anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
segments.mn143:16.2: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati, acirapakkante āyasmante ca sāriputte āyasmante ca ānande, kālamakāsi tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji.
segments.mn143:17.1: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.mn143:17.2: Ekamantaṃ jṭhito kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.mn143:17.7: “Kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca, sīlaṃ jīvitamuttamaṃ;
segments.mn143:17.9: Etena maccā sujjhanti, na gottena dhanena vā.
segments.mn143:17.13: Yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
segments.mn143:18.4: “samanuñño me satthā”ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.mn143:19.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.mn143:19.2: “imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.mn143:19.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so devaputto maṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.mn143:19.8: “Kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca, sīlaṃ jīvitamuttamaṃ;
segments.mn143:19.10: Etena maccā sujjhanti, na gottena dhanena vā.
segments.mn143:19.14: Yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
segments.mn143:19.21: ‘Samanuñño me satthā’ti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
segments.mn143:20.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn143:20.2: “so hi nūna so, bhante, anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati.
segments.mn143:20.3: Anāthapiṇḍiko, bhante, gahapati āyasmante sāriputte abhippasanno ahosī”ti.
segments.mn143:20.5: Yāvatakaṃ kho, ānanda, takkāya pattabbaṃ, anuppattaṃ taṃ tayā.
segments.mn143:20.8: Attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Āmantesīti gahapatissa kira yāva pādā vahiṃsu, tāva divase sakiṃ vā dvikkhattuṃ vā tikkhattuṃ vā buddhupaṭṭhānaṃ akhaṇḍaṃ akāsi.
Yattakañcassa satthu upaṭṭhānaṃ ahosi, tattakaṃyeva mahātherānaṃ.
So ajja gamanapādassa pacchinnattā anuṭṭhānaseyyaṃ upagato sāsanaṃ pesetukāmo aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi.

Abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti yasmiñhi samaye māraṇantikā vedanā uppajjati, uparivāte jalitaggi viya hoti, yāva usmā na pariyādiyati, tāva mahatāpi upakkamena na sakkā vūpasametuṃ, usmāya pana pariyādinnāya vūpasammati.
“ayaṃ mahāseṭṭhissa vedanā māraṇantikā, na sakkā paṭibāhituṃ, avasesā kathā niratthakā, dhammakathamassa kathessāmī”ti.
Tattha tasmāti yasmā cakkhuṃ tīhi gāhehi gaṇhanto uppannaṃ māraṇantikaṃ vedanaṃ paṭibāhituṃ samattho nāma natthi, tasmā.
Na cakkhuṃ upādiyissāmīti cakkhuṃ tīhi gāhehi na gaṇhissāmi.
Na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāpi me cakkhunissitaṃ na bhavissati.
Na rūpanti heṭṭhā āyatanarūpaṃ kathitaṃ, imasmiṃ ṭhāne sabbampi kāmabhavarūpaṃ kathento evamāha.
Na idhalokanti vasanaṭṭhānaṃ vā ghāsacchādanaṃ vā na upādiyissāmīti attho.
Na paralokanti ettha pana manussalokaṃ ṭhapetvā sesā paralokā nāma.
“asukadevaloke nibbattitvā asukaṭṭhāne bhavissāmi, idaṃ nāma khādissāmi bhuñjissāmi nivāsessāmi pārupissāmī”ti evarūpāya paritassanāya pahānatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
Tampi na upādiyissāmi, na ca me tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti evaṃ tīhi gāhehi parimocetvā thero desanaṃ arahattanikūṭena niṭṭhapesi.
Olīyasīti attano sampattiṃ disvā ārammaṇesu bajjhasi allīyasīti.
“ayampi nāma gahapati evaṃ saddho pasanno maraṇabhayassa bhāyati, añño ko na bhāyissatī”ti maññamāno tassa gāḷhaṃ katvā ovādaṃ dento evamāha.
Na ca me evarūpī dhammīkathā sutapubbāti ayaṃ upāsako –
“satthu santikāpi me evarūpī dhammakathā na sutapubbā”ti vadati, kiṃ satthā evarūpi sukhumaṃ gambhīrakathaṃ na kathetīti?

Evaṃ pana cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni cha bāhirāni cha viññāṇakāye cha phassakāye cha vedanākāye cha dhātuyo pañcakkhandhe cattāro arūpe idhalokañca paralokañca dassetvā diṭṭhasutamutaviññātavasena arahatte pakkhipitvā kathitakathā etena na sutapubbā, tasmā evaṃ vadati.
Apicāyaṃ upāsako dānādhimutto dānābhirato buddhānaṃ santikaṃ gacchanto tucchahattho na gatapubbo.
Purebhattaṃ gacchanto yāgukhajjakādīni gāhāpetvā gacchati, pacchābhattaṃ sappimadhuphāṇitādīni.
Tasmiṃ asati vālikaṃ gāhāpetvā gandhakuṭipariveṇe okirāpeti, dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ rakkhitvā gehaṃ gato.
Bodhisattagatiko kiresa upāsako, tasmā bhagavā catuvīsati saṃvaccharāni upāsakassa yebhuyyena dānakathameva kathesi –
“upāsaka, idaṃ dānaṃ nāma bodhisattānaṃ gatamaggo, mayhampi gatamaggo, mayā satasahassakappādhikāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni dānaṃ dinnaṃ, tvaṃ mayā gatamaggameva anugacchasī”ti.
Dhammasenāpatiādayo mahāsāvakāpi attano attano santikaṃ āgatakāle dānakathamevassa kathenti.
Tenevāha na kho gahapati gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammīkathā paṭibhātīti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – gahapati gihīnaṃ nāma khettavatthuhiraññasuvaṇṇadāsīdāsaputtabhariyādīsu tibbo ālayo tibbaṃ nikantipariyuṭṭhānaṃ, tesaṃ –
“ettha ālayo na kātabbo, nikanti na kātabbā”ti kathā na paṭibhāti na ruccatīti.
Tusitabhavane kirassa nibbattamattasseva tigāvutappamāṇaṃ suvaṇṇakkhandhaṃ viya vijjotamānaṃ attabhāvaṃ uyyānavimānādisampattiñca disvā –

“mahatī ayaṃ mayhaṃ sampatti, kiṃ nu kho me manussapathe kammaṃ katan”ti olokento tīsu ratanesu adhikāraṃ disvā cintesi “pamādaṭṭhānamidaṃ devattaṃ nāma, imāya hi me sampattiyā modamānassa satisammosopi siyā, handāhaṃ gantvā mama jetavanassa ceva bhikkhusaṅghassa ca tathāgatassa ca ariyamaggassa ca sāriputtattherassa ca vaṇṇaṃ kathetvā tato āgantvā sampattiṃ anubhavissāmī”ti.
Evaṃ paṭhamagāthāya jetavanassa vaṇṇaṃ kathetvā idāni ariyamaggassa vaṇṇaṃ kathento kammaṃ vijjā cātiādimāha.
Sīlaṃ jīvitamuttamanti sīle patiṭṭhitassa jīvitaṃ uttamanti dasseti.
Jīvitamuttamanti etasmiṃ sīle patiṭṭhitassa jīvitaṃ nāma uttamaṃ.
Etena maccā sujjhantīti etena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena sattā visujjhanti.
Tasmāti yasmā maggena sujjhanti, na gottadhanehi, tasmā.
Yoniso vicine dhammanti upāyena samādhipakkhiyaṃ dhammaṃ vicineyya.
Evaṃ tattha visujjhatīti evaṃ tasmiṃ ariyamagge visujjhati.
Atha vā yoniso vicine dhammanti upāyena pañcakkhandhadhammaṃ vicineyya.
Evaṃ tattha visujjhatīti evaṃ tesu catūsu saccesu visujjhati.
Yo koci nibbānaṃ patto bhikkhu, so etāvaparamo siyā, na therena uttaritaro nāma atthīti vadati.

lines: Idhalokanti ettha saṅkhāralokavisayoti adhippāyena,“vasanaṭṭhānaṃ vā”tiādi vuttaṃ, tañca kho paṭhamadutiyavārehi idhaloko gahitoti katvā.
Paṭhamadutiyavārehi pana idhaloko paralokoti vibhāgena vinā pañcavokārabhavo gahito;
tathā tatiyavāre pañcavokārabhavo catuvokārabhavo ca gahitoti puna diṭṭhadhammasamparāyavasena taṃ vibhajitvā dassetuṃ,“na idhalokan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Sabbampi saṅkhāravasena pariggahetvā dassetuṃ,“yampi me diṭṭhan”tiādi vuttanti keci.
Yassa diṭṭhadhammoti vuccati, tassa pana abhāvato,“manussalokaṃ ṭhapetvā sesā paralokā nāmā”ti vuttaṃ.
Yesaṃ pana “idhalokan”ti iminā sattalokassapi gahaṇaṃ icchitaṃ.
Allīyasīti attabhāve bhogesu ca apekkhaṃ karosīti attho.
Dhammakathā na sutapubbāti yathākathitākārameva sandhāya paṭikkhepo, na sukhumagambhīrasuññatāpaṭisaṃyuttatāsāmaññaṃ.
Mayā gatamaggameva anugacchasīti dānamayapuññabhāvasāmaññaṃ gahetvā vadati, na bodhisattadānabhūtaṃ dānapāramitaṃ.
Esitaguṇattā esiyamānaguṇattā ca isi, asekkhā sekkhā kalyāṇaputhujjanā ca, isīnaṃ saṅgho, tena nisevitanti isisaṅghanisevitaṃ.

Kāmaṃ tassa vihārassa gandhakuṭipāsādakūṭāgārādivasena nisīdananipajjanāya rukkhalatādivasena bhūmisayādivasena ca anaññasādhāraṇā mahatī ramaṇīyatā attheva, sā pana gehassitabhāvena ariyānaṃ cittaṃ tathā na toseti;
“yattha arahanto viharanti, taṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakan”ti (dha. pa.98; theragā.991; saṃ. ni.1.261).
Catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ viditakaraṇaṭṭhena kilesānaṃ vikkhambhanaṭṭhena ca vijjā, maggasammādiṭṭhīti āha –
Tathā hi so paññākkhandhasaṅgahitoti vuccati, yathā sammāsaṅkappo paññākkhandhena saṅgahito, evaṃ vāyāmasatiyo samādhikkhandhasaṅgahitāti.
“evaṃ dhammā te bhagavanto ahesun”tiādīsu (dī. ni.2.13; ma. ni.3.198; saṃ. ni.5.378) viya.
Vācākammantājīvāti sammāvācākammantājīvā maggapariyāpannā eva, te sabbepi gahitāti.
Upāyenāti yena vidhinā ariyamaggo bhāvetabbo, tena samādhipakkhiyaṃ vipassanādhammañceva maggadhammañca.
“Ariyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, sammāsamādhiṃ desessāmi saupanisaṃ saparikkhāran”ti (ma. ni.3.136) hi vacanato sammāsamādhiādayo maggadhammāpi samādhipakkhiyā.

Yadaggena dukkhasaccaṃ pariññāpaṭivedhena paṭivijjhīyati, tadaggena samudayasaccaṃ pahānapaṭivedhena nirodhasaccaṃ sacchikiriyāpaṭivedhena, maggasaccaṃ bhāvanāpaṭivedhena paṭivijjhīyati, evaṃ accantavisuddhiyā sujjhati.
Sāriputtovāti ca avadhāraṇaṃ tassa sāvakabhāvato sāvakesu sāriputtova seyyoti imamatthaṃ dīpeti.
Kilesaupasamenāti iminā mahātherassa tādiso kilesūpasamoti dasseti, yassa sāvakassa visaye paññāya pāramippatti ahosi.
“yopi pāraṅgato bhikkhu, etāvaparamo siyā”ti idaṃ kathanti?
Tesaṃ tesaṃ buddhānaṃ sāsane paññāya pāramippattasāvakavasenetaṃ vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
“natthi vimuttiyā nānattan”ti (dī. ni. ṭī.3.141; vibha. mūlaṭī. suttantabhājanīyavaṇṇanā) vacanato sāvakehi vimuttipaññāmattaṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ.
